mapper.select: SELECT p.code AS "code", p.name AS "name", p.spec AS "spec" FROM products p WHERE COALESCE(p.discontinued, 0) = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bom b WHERE b.product_code = p.code)
SELECT code AS "code", name AS "name", spec AS "spec" FROM products ORDER BY code
SELECT material_code AS "materialCode", material_name AS "materialName", ratio_percent AS "ratioPercent" FROM bom WHERE product_code = #{productCode} ORDER BY rank_in_product
SELECT code AS "code", name AS "name", spec AS "spec", COALESCE(stock_qty, 0) AS "stockQty" FROM materials
SELECT material_code AS "code", SUM(qty) AS "qty" FROM material_receiving WHERE receive_date > #{date} GROUP BY material_code
SELECT u.material_code AS "code", SUM(u.qty_used) AS "qty" FROM production_material_usage u JOIN production_schedule s ON u.schedule_id = s.id WHERE s.schedule_date > #{date} GROUP BY u.material_code
SELECT material_code AS "code", SUM(COALESCE(in_qty, 0)) - SUM(COALESCE(out_qty, 0)) AS "qty" FROM material_stock_movement WHERE SUBSTRING(created_at, 1, 10) > #{date} GROUP BY material_code

SELECT material_code AS "code", SUM(COALESCE(new_stock_qty, 0) - COALESCE(old_stock_qty, 0)) AS "qty" FROM material_stock_schedule WHERE applied = 1 AND effective_date > #{date} GROUP BY material_code
